deploy-bot: START - staging deploy initiated: service=inference-runtime environment=staging tag=v2.3.8-rc4 commit=abc1234 author=@natalie change_window=2025-03-10T22:00Z rollout=canary(5%->50%->100%) steps=[preflight, canary, smoke, traffic-shift] run: https://ci.redwood/internal/runs/1234
elaine: 👍 kicking off preflight checks. @chris can you watch the canary smoke? I'll start log collection.
chris: on it. watching reranker logs and p99 latency. ping me if we see >200ms p99 or error-rate >0.5%
natalie: small note: pin current prod model to v2.3.7 for safety if we see quality regressions. we'll abort/rollback if reranker drift >2%
mike: preflight done: disk pressure ok, GPU allocs green. rolling out to 5% now.
deploy-bot: UPDATE - canary at 5% complete: health=OK, errors=0.02%, avg-latency=43ms, p99=160ms, smoke-tests=FAIL (1/12): reranker-regression flagged. logs: https://artifacts.redwood/ci/1234/failed-test.log
elaine: ugh. can someone paste the failing assertion? don't want to jump to rollback yet.
chris: failing case looks like reranker score decreased on a short prompt - possible model variant mismatch. investigating diff between v2.3.7 and rc4 quantization table.
natalie: PAUSE traffic shift. tagging release: HOLD. @deploy-bot pause.
deploy-bot: ACTION - traffic shift paused at 5%. canary frozen. awaiting manual go/no-go.
mike: i'll spin a repro job against the failing prompt and post stack traces.
deploy-bot: NOTE - runbook snapshot saved: https://runbook.redwood/deploys/1234/snapshot.txt
[~8m later]
deploy-bot: REDEPLOY - test build with fallback-activation flag true (feature_gate) started: commit=abc1234+hotfix reason="reranker fallback enabled for narrow prompts"
deploy-bot: UPDATE - redeploy canary at 5% complete: health=OK, smoke-tests=PASS (12/12), p99=158ms, regressions=none. artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/ci/1234/hotfix.log
natalie: looks good to me. proceed to 50% then 100% if metrics hold for 10m. @chris keep an eye.
chris: watching — metrics stable for 10m, no error spike, p99 steady under 170ms.
deploy-bot: COMPLETE - staging deploy finished: service=inference-runtime tag=v2.3.8-rc4-hotfix rollout=100% commit=abc1234+hotfix duration=18m notes="canary held for reranker regression; hotfix gated and applied; smoke tests all pass" artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/ci/1234/summary.json
elaine: :tada: thanks team. i'll draft a short release note and capture the quant-table change in the migration doc.
natalie: requesting pin of prod to v2.3.8-rc4-hotfix for next prod deploy window. filing ticket PLAT-5522.
mike: leaving logs and repro job details under /ops/deploys/1234 for postmortem.
chris: thumbs up. will add a quick monitoring alert for reranker drift on prod once pin is applied.
